title: Add integration event before inserting the cost allocation journal line
summary: Cost Allocation report now exposes an integration event that allows extensions to modify cost journal lines before they are inserted into the temporary journal.
key_points: New integration event OnWriteJournalLineOnBeforeInsertTempCostJournalLine added to Cost Allocation report
Event fires before each temporary cost journal line is inserted
Event passes the journal line by reference and the Cost Allocation Source for context
Purely additive change with no impact on existing logic or data
Provides extension point for customizing cost allocation data
quote: adds the integration event OnWriteJournalLineOnBeforeInsertTempCostJournalLine right before the temporary line insert
